# DexRewards 3.2.0 (Cobblemon 1.8.0 / Minecraft 1.21.1)

DexRewards has been rebuilt for Cobblemon 1.8.0. This release adds **all-forms dexes**, **Pokémon rewards**, item components, a more flexible rewards GUI and a new set of placeholders, and fixes shiny dexes counting Pokémon that weren't actually caught as shinies.

> [!WARNING]
> **This update changes the config formats and placeholders.** Back up `config/DexRewards/` before you update, then delete `messages.json`, `reward_gui.json` and the `dex_types/` folder and let DexRewards generate new ones. Copy your customizations back in using the [Wiki](https://github.com/Unariginal/Cobblemon-DexRewards/wiki) as a reference.

## ✨ New

- **All-forms dexes:** set `require_all_forms` on a dex type to count every form separately. Alolan Vulpix, Galarian Meowth and each Rotom appliance form all count on their own. Use `ignored_forms` to skip forms that can't be caught, such as Mega and Gigantamax forms.
- **Pokémon rewards:** give Pokémon with `"type": "pokemon"`, written like `/givepokemon`, e.g. `"magikarp shiny=yes level=1"`. A full party sends them to the PC.
- **Item components:** reward items, group icons and GUI items use Minecraft's item format, so they can have custom names, lore, enchantments and any other component.
- **Random item amounts:** item rewards have `min_count` and `max_count`.
- **Default dex type:** `default_dex_type` in `config.json` sets which dex `/dex rewards` opens with no argument.
- **Per-dex reset:** `/dex reset <player> <dex-type>` now resets only that dex type.
- **Rewards GUI:**
  - A close button.
  - Any number of chest rows, or a hopper GUI.
  - Enchantment glint per group state. Claimable groups glint by default.
  - A separate icon for locked groups.
- **Placeholders:** a new set of placeholders. Dex type placeholders take an optional dex type, e.g. `%player_dex_count kanto%`. See [Placeholder changes](#-placeholder-changes).
- **Config warnings:** a dex type with an unknown Pokédex is skipped with an error, and a dex type whose filters leave no Pokémon logs a warning.

## 🔧 Changes

- **Shiny-caught dexes are accurate now.** A dex with `require_caught` and `require_shiny` only counts Pokémon the player has actually obtained as a shiny. Before, catching a normal Pokémon and seeing a shiny of the same species also counted. Shinies already in a player's party or PC count automatically when they join.
- **Progress updates on every Pokédex change**: seeing, scanning or catching a Pokémon, and changing an owned Pokémon's form. Seen dexes no longer wait for a catch or a `/pokedex` command.
- **New config formats** for `messages.json`, `reward_gui.json` and dex types. See the [Wiki](https://github.com/Unariginal/Cobblemon-DexRewards/wiki).
- **Better performance:** filters are worked out once on load instead of on every Pokédex change, and player data is only saved when something changed. Saves happen in the background.
- Command rewards no longer show command feedback in chat.
- If `config.json`, `messages.json` or `reward_gui.json` has a JSON error, DexRewards keeps using the last working version instead of failing.

## 🐛 Fixes

- Fixed `/dex reload` breaking `/dex rewards` until a restart when players were online.
- Fixed player data files possibly being corrupted if the server stopped while saving.

## 🗑️ Removed

- `/dex generate` and its `dexrewards.generate` permission.

## 🔁 Placeholder Changes

All placeholders were replaced. Placeholder API placeholders now use the `dexrewards:` namespace.

| Old | New |
|---|---|
| `%dex_type%` | `%dex_type%` *(unchanged)* |
| `%pokedex.total%` | `%pokedex_total%` |
| `%group.name%` | `%group_name%` |
| `%group.percent%` | `%group_percent%` |
| `%player.dex_count%` | `%player_dex_count%` |
| `%player.dex_percent%` | `%player_dex_percent%` |
| `%player.reward_group%` | `%player_reward_group%` |
| `%national:total%` | `%dexrewards:pokedex_total national%` |

...
